pages.text: Akaishi Crystals are obtained from ore clusters, the starting point of the tech line. $(bold)Mining a cluster with a pickaxe drops crystals directly$(reset); no smelting or machinery is required.$(br2)$(bold)Locations:$(reset) ore clusters are found in the Overworld (stone and deepslate layers), the Nether and the End.$(br2)$(bold)Note:$(reset) a pickaxe is required for any drop. Collect a full stack of crystals first; refining and power generation both depend on them.

There are $(bold)4 kinds$(reset) of cluster: 4 environments (Overworld, Deepslate, Nether, End) × one density grade (Medium).$(br2)$(bold)Drops are fixed:$(reset) 2 crystals per block. Fortune has no effect here; Silk Touch allows the whole cluster to be collected.$(br2)For conversion of mined ore into essence and ingots, see $(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystal & Essence$(/l).

Ore is finite; Akaishi Crystal Geodes (akaishi_geode_*) produce clusters automatically, and a Catalyst combined with a Collector turns this into mass production (see the Advanced Industry chapter). Initially, feed mined ore into the Purifier to obtain essence.
